lines.zh: 用利爪在地上划出印记。
我拖着掠夺者的靴子，走了很久。
lines.en: I drag the pillager's boots a long way.

lines.zh: 苍白的影子在洞壁上来回。
lines.en: A pale shadow paces the cave wall.
Staring into the distance, empty eyes.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的弩，现在归它用。
lines.en: The pillager's crossbow serves it now.
Sharp gaze locked on the player.
Sibilant hiss, closing in on the player.
Pointing with claws at the player.
Sibilant hiss, gesturing to the player.
I stand in the doorway, waiting.
Sharp gaze pinned on the player.

lines.zh: 我的脸在动，却不是我在动。
lines.en: My face moves, but not by my will.

lines.zh: 苍白恶魔……夺走了我的意志……
lines.en: The Pale Demon... took my will...

lines.zh: 疼一下，我才想起自己是谁。
lines.en: A moment of pain and I remember who I was.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，它似乎想要撕裂一切。
lines.en: Sssss, it wants to tear everything apart.

lines.zh: 苍白的皮肤下涌动着邪恶的欲望。
lines.en: Evil desires pulse beneath its pale skin.

lines.zh: 它的目光中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: Its gaze shines with greedy light.

lines.zh: 近了，近了，它能闻到恐惧的味道。
咬紧牙关，它几乎要失控。
lines.en: Tighten your teeth, it’s almost out of control.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，这是它唯一的语言。
它的眼睛紧紧盯着你，渴望吞噬你。
lines.en: Its eyes fixed on you, eager to consume you.

lines.zh: 它的动作变得迟缓，但仍充满危险。
lines.en: Its movements are sluggish, but still dangerous.

lines.zh: 它开始寻找下一个猎物。
lines.en: It begins to seek its next prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼神空洞，但力量依旧强大。
lines.en: Its eyes empty, but strength still strong.

lines.zh: 碰撞时它的灵魂似乎颤抖。
lines.en: Its soul seems to tremble on impact.

lines.zh: 苍白的躯体在碰撞中破碎。
lines.en: Its pale body shatters in collision.

lines.zh: 它在碰撞中发出凄厉的尖啸。
lines.en: It gives a piercing screech in collision.

lines.zh: 它的武器在碰撞中变得扭曲。
它在碰撞中失去了平衡。
它的触角在碰撞中断裂。
它在碰撞中失去了焦点。
它的身体在碰撞中变形。
它在碰撞中发出低沉的咆哮。
它寻找着同类，渴望交配。
lines.en: It searches for mates, yearning to breed.

lines.zh: 它用触角碰触同伴的身体。
lines.en: It uses its tentacles to touch its companion.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛发出温柔的光芒。
它在月光下变得更加亲密。
lines.en: It becomes more intimate under moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的身体互相缠绕在一起。

lines.en: It communicates with a special language.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了爱意。
lines.en: Its gaze is full of love.

lines.zh: 它们之间的连接超越了肉体。
它在交配中释放出魔法。
苍白之光闪烁在你周围

lines.en: It bites you, cold and致命

lines.zh: 它的爪子在你身上划过

lines.en: It lets out a deep growl
Its hiss is like a cold wind
The pillager's crossbow is on you.
I raise my claws and pause a beat.

lines.zh: 有东西借我的手伸向你。
lines.en: Something reaches through my hand at you.

lines.zh: 弩先抬起来了，手却不是我抬的。
lines.en: The crossbow rises, but not by my hand.
The voice says it is you.

lines.zh: 我举起了弩，手却不听我的。
lines.en: I raise my crossbow, but my hand disobeys.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的旧习还在我身上。
lines.en: The pillager's old habits still live in me.

lines.zh: 你身上有火光，我不喜欢火光。
lines.en: You carry firelight. I dislike firelight.

lines.zh: 洞里的一切都归那东西管。
lines.en: Everything in the cave answers to that thing.
The bolt is faster than my eyes.

lines.zh: 它的怒吼在你心中回响
lines.en: Its roar echoes in your heart

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，在听它的吩咐。
lines.en: My head tilts, listening to its orders.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，弩却瞄得很稳。
lines.en: My hand trembles, but the crossbow aims true.
It tells me to close in first, then strike.
I drive you deeper into the cave.

lines.zh: 我的刀口上有苍白的霜。
它数着你的心跳，一下一下。
lines.en: It counts your heartbeats, one by one.

lines.zh: 等你退到水边，就没路了。
lines.en: Once you back to the water, there is no way left.

lines.zh: 我的爪子撕开你的领口。

lines.en: These claws are not my own.
A demon pulls my crossbow string.
This claw will stay with you.

lines.zh: 痛苦将是你最后的礼物！
lines.en: Pain will be your final gift!
I did not swing this blade.

lines.zh: 弩箭穿进你的肩，霜化了。
lines.en: The bolt pierces your shoulder, frost melting.

lines.zh: 苍白的指甲抓过你的护甲。
lines.en: Pale nails rake across your armor.

lines.zh: 我听见自己在笑，可我不在。
lines.en: I hear myself laughing, but I am not there.

lines.zh: 它借我的手，掐住你的喉咙。
lines.en: It uses my hands to close on your throat.

lines.zh: 我咬你一口，嘴里全是灰。
lines.en: I bite you and my mouth fills with ash.

lines.zh: 洞里走出一名被附身的掠夺者。
lines.en: A possessed pillager walks out of the cave.

lines.zh: 那件灰袍下面，没有影子。
lines.en: Beneath that grey robe, there is no shadow.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……我从高处摔了下来……
lines.en: Sss... I fell from a height...
Sss... I fell into the void...
